findings.title: DesC assay evidence cites pathway figures instead of the assay figure
findings.summary: Two edge-local primary locators cite Figures 2–3, which show chemical structures and the pathway schematic. The actual succinyl/acetyl LC-MS assay traces are Figure 4(a)/(b). The cited Results section and separate SI evidence support both assertions, so this is a bounded locator error with no chemistry/catalyst change.

before.source_assertion: Purified tagged DesC from coelicolor catalyzed N-hydroxycadaverine acylation with succinyl-CoA, giving the corresponding authentic-standard-matched product and CoA.
before.source_locator: PMC5915712 Results and discussion §2(a); Figures 2–3; original supplementary assays
